## LLM006 produces is missing charset

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | yes: `--fix` (or `--fix --write` to apply it) |
| More | https://pgy763.github.io/llm-dev-pitfalls/java/SSE响应中文乱码 |
| Turn it off | `LLM006: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM006` on the command line |

text/event-stream without charset: Spring writes the String with the default encoding, so Chinese shows up as question marks in the browser while the endpoint still returns 200.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM006` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm006 -->

## What it looks like

`@GetMapping(produces = "text/event-stream")` without a charset.

## How to fix

Use `text/event-stream;charset=UTF-8` (or `MediaType.TEXT_EVENT_STREAM_VALUE + ";charset=UTF-8"`); `--fix` can patch this one.
